findings.correction: “Not bad loyalty. Their ability’s pathetic, though.”
findings.current: “You’ve got some loyalty, I’ll give you that. Your skills are pathetic, though.”
findings.defect: The line is spoken while Jopil is looking back; the next sentence identifies the approaching squad as the object of that gaze. Draft assigns both 충성심 and 실력 to Taekyung via “you/your,” and 실력 becomes game-like “skills.”
findings.rationale: After 뒤를 돌아보고, 시선 끝 is the clustered reconnaissance members, then 저놈들을 찢어 죽일까. The evaluation is of the rescuers, not of Taekyung’s martial skill.
findings.source: “충성심이 제법이군. 실력은 형편없지만 말이야.” / 놈의 시선 끝에는 한 무더기가 되어 달려오는 정찰조원들이 있었다.

findings.correction: “…ly. Fought.” / “Stupid… fought.” / “I said I’ve been fighting stupidly this whole time.”
findings.current: “…I fought stupidly.” / “Stupid… I fought stupidly.” / “I said I’ve been fighting stupidly.”
findings.defect: The first two lines are injured fragments; 멍청하게 is only complete in the third. Draft supplies “stupidly” twice early and drops 그동안.
findings.rationale: The gag and Jopil’s 말도 똑바로 못하나? depend on the meaning arriving only on the last repetition.

findings.correction: “If King Yama asks, tell him I sent you.”
findings.current: “If Yama asks, tell him I sent you.”
findings.defect: 염왕 is King Yama / the King of Hell. Bare “Yama” reads as the already-established Peak master Yama Whip.
findings.rationale: Ledger/continuity already uses Yama as Yama Whip’s title; this is a mythic psychopomp, not that character.

findings.correction: Jopil’s face lit with ecstasy as he declared it to me, limp as a corpse in his grip. “Die.”
findings.current: Jopil looked ecstatic as he declared it to me, hanging limp like a corpse. “Die.”
findings.defect: The participial phrase attaches to Jopil, so the corpse-limp body reads as his, not Taekyung’s.
findings.rationale: 시체처럼 축 늘어져 있는 내게 is Taekyung; Jopil is the one declaring 죽어 before the last palm.
findings.source: 말없이 시체처럼 축 늘어져 있는 내게, 조필이 환희에 찬 얼굴로 선언했다. “죽어.”

findings.correction: From the neck caught in Jopil’s grip came the sound of bones slipping out of alignment.
findings.current: From the throat caught in Jopil’s grip came the sound of bones slipping out of alignment.
findings.defect: 목 here is the neck being wrung; “throat” mismatches the bone-displacement sound.
findings.rationale: 어긋나는 뼈 is cervical; 목 in this grip is the neck, not the throat.
findings.source: 조필의 손아귀에 잡힌 목에서 뼈가 어긋나는 소리가 들렸다.

findings.correction: “I can’t die like this. This makes no sense.”
findings.current: “This can’t be happening. I can’t die like this. This makes no sense.”
findings.defect: Adds a third sentence and front-loads a line the Korean does not have.
findings.rationale: Two clauses only: refusal of this death, then 말도 안 돼.
findings.source: “이렇게 죽을 수는 없어. 이건 말도 안 돼.”

findings.correction: Me and Jopil. / Jopil and me.
findings.current: Jopil and me. / Me and Jopil.
findings.rationale: Source order is 나와 조필 then 조필과 나.

findings.correction: the nineteenth-generation successor of the Fire Gate Clan
findings.current: The nineteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan
findings.defect: 십구 대 marks generation, not merely the nineteenth person to succeed.
findings.rationale: 대 in 십구 대 계승자 is generational lineage, not a simple successor count.

summary: Subject errors and over-completed broken speech distort who Jopil is mocking and how the blood-spit beat lands; 염왕 as bare “Yama” collides with Yama Whip.
